text_block_list.text:
On my way to the training course to pick 
up something I forgot…

This time, the "President Showdown" is in 
the gym! We have to hurry up and cheer on 
Baku-chan!

I was curious, so I took a look in the gym 
to find――

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
As class "president," I'll make absolutely 
sure of it! I shall win!

text_block_list.name: Classmates
text_block_list.text:
Fight on, Baku-chan! Let's see what you're 
made of!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: That's my line! I'm going to turn you into dust with my armband of the Public Morals "President"!

text_block_list.name: PM Committee Member
text_block_list.text:
Gyaaa―! President of Public Morals～! I've 
got tingles～～!

…I was originally going to go get the 
thing I forgot, but I ran into a hell of a 
showdown!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer! You've come to support me!?
choice_data_list:
No, I was on my way to get something I 
forgot…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
What's this!? If that's the case, then 
you're most certainly in luck! To have 
come across such a historic battle!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
The "President Showdown" to determine the 
president among presidents …So far, it's 
been a series of draws!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Whoever wins today, the greatest of presidents! Shall she become…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: The question is, what should the showdown be this time? For the 50th round, what the meat of it should consist of is…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, yes! Earlier, Trainer said you were 
going to go get something you forgot, were 
you not!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
How about finding the Trainer's lost item 
and whoever returns first is declared the 
winner… Now what do you think of that!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I have no objection! Because the ability to help others, a good role model makes!

And so, the curtain rose on the battle for 
the "President Showdown"――

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
The winner of the "Deliver Trainer's Lost 
Item Grand Championship Title," the grand 
victor――is me!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Uuuuuuugh～!! I lost…! I couldn't even see 
the back of you……!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
However……Trainer, aren't you still 
forgetting something!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
…The class president knows. The class 
president knows that you haven't eaten for 
a while now, because you've been working 
on our practice menu.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
So, for my purposes, that is the next best 
thing to really having forgotten 
something. However, what you're really 
forgetting is――

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: "Giving Your Hardworking Self a Break"…!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Now, let's not delay, let's go! First, 
let's get that stomach to start 
Bakushin-ing up some food!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: So this is the "class" president… I was completely and utterly annihilated. Both by her legs and the depth of her feelings.

text_block_list.name: Crowd
text_block_list.text:
Truly the president among presidents…! 
Mesmerizing～～!

Afterwards, we ate yakisoba noodles so 
large they reminded us of the magnitude of 
the class president's feelings… We were 
full in both stomach and heart!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I did it, I did it―!! Now the strongest 
class president, is me!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Kuuuu! That's the power of Bakushin, alright! What speed…!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ehhen! That is true… however! It's all 
thanks to my Trainer, too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I shall help my Trainer! And while I was 
running, I remembered our usual training!
choice_data_list:
You've put what you've learned to good 
use!

You've put what you've learned to good 
use!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
My Trainer helped me! I delivered the 
forgotten item, and that I can return the 
favor… I'm pleased as can be about!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Aaaaack―! A complete and utter annihilation! And the bond between the two of you was so touchiiing～～!

text_block_list.name: Crowd
text_block_list.text:
That was such a great fight! Thanks for 
the truly moving display! 
Congratulations～～!

The reigning winner, Sakura Bakushin O, 
continued to bask in the applause of the 
crowd!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Uuuuuuughhh～～! I cannot believe my 
Bakushin has been… defeated……

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: This is the power of the Public Morals President! I'll take the title of the strongest president!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Frustrating… This is, frustrating…!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
However! Defeat shall also become 
Bakushin's renewed strength!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I'm determined to win next time! Until 
then, you can keep the position!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Fu… Now that makes me a happy president to hear that!

text_block_list.name: Crowd
text_block_list.text: Class presideeent! Good try―!!

The whole gym applauded Sakura Bakushin 
O's passion.
